title: Understanding Normalization
text: Normalization is a technique often used in data preprocessing to scale the data to a specific range, usually between $$0$$ and $$1$$. This helps in improving the performance and stability of the model.

title: Why Normalize Age?
text: Normalizing age values between $$0$$ and $$1$$ ensures that the age feature has the same scale as other features, preventing it from dominating the model due to its larger range.

title: How to Normalize Age
text: To normalize age values between $$0$$ and $$1$$, use the formula: $$normalized_{age}=\frac{age-min_{age}}{max_{age}-min_{age}}$$.

title: Using Normalized Age in the Model
text: Once age is normalized, it can be used as a feature in the model. This ensures that the model treats age on the same scale as other features, improving model performance.
